descriptor: Balanced-Cell Fresh-World Replication, Within-Context Geometry Stability, Cell-Identity Reproducibility & World-Specific Residual Decomposition

prospective_design.contexts: all 12 cells of the balanced 3-skin × 4-intervention grid
prospective_design.fresh_instance_change: new opaque history/key identities only; semantic task, skin, intervention, claim template, representation transformations, and adjudication are held fixed

presealed_predictions.exact_cell_geometry: fresh 32-bit row equals the sealed P31 canonical row for that skin×intervention cell
presealed_predictions.cell_identity: fresh row's unique nearest Hamming neighbor among the 12 sealed canonical rows is its own context cell

frozen_rules.vertex_pass: valid and null semantic-twin packets are both packet-correct
frozen_rules.exact_geometry_reproducible: 12/12 fresh rows exactly equal their own canonical rows
frozen_rules.cell_identity_reproducible: 12/12 fresh rows have their own canonical row as unique nearest Hamming neighbor
frozen_rules.residual: fresh row XOR own canonical row
frozen_rules.world_specific_residual_dimension: GF(2) rank of the 12×32 residual matrix

authority: Prospective within-cell reproducibility and residual-geometry adjudication only. No causal context-law or behavioral SVEC promotion.
